lines.en: Last week was a busy week.
On Monday, a parent called me.
lines.zh: 星期一，一位家长给我打电话。

lines.en: Her child had a fever.
We can arrange a make-up class.
The make-up class was on Wednesday.
On Friday, I went to the dentist.
On Saturday, I went to a wedding.
lines.zh: 星期六，我去参加了婚礼。

lines.en: It rained all day.
On Sunday, my parents had dinner with me.
lines.zh: 星期天，我父母来和我一起吃晚饭。

lines.en: It was my birthday!
I cooked chicken rice, and we watched a movie.
lines.zh: 我做了鸡饭，我们还看了一部电影。

lines.en: It was a good week.

dialogue.title: 约朋友吃晚饭
dialogue.setting: 星期四晚上，朋友 Lily 打电话给 Amy，想约她周末见面吃饭。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: Hi Amy! Are you free on Saturday?
lines.zh: 嗨 Amy！你星期六有空吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sorry, I have a wedding on Saturday.
lines.zh: 不好意思，我星期六要去参加婚礼。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: Can we meet on Sunday?
lines.zh: 我们星期天见面可以吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Let me check my calendar.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sunday is okay. What time is good for you?
lines.zh: 星期天可以。你什么时间方便？

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: Is 6pm okay for you?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: No problem. Can we have dinner together?
lines.zh: 没问题。我们一起吃晚饭好吗？

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: Sure! What did you do last weekend?
lines.zh: 好啊！你上周末做了什么？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I stayed at home. It rained all day.
lines.zh: 我待在家里。下了一整天的雨。

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: I went shopping with my sister.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Nice! What did you buy?

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.en: I bought some new clothes.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Very nice! See you on Sunday!
